$ grep root /etc/passwd
root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
$ grep -c nologin /etc/passwd
22
$ grep -n '^root' /etc/passwd /etc/group
/etc/passwd:1:root:x:0:0:root:/root:/bin/bash
/etc/group:1:root:x:0:
$ grep -v nologin /etc/passwd | cut -d: -f1
root
sync
mysql
ubuntu
$ grep -i ROOT /etc/hostname
[exit 1]
$ grep -E 'root|ubuntu' /etc/group
root:x:0:
adm:x:4:syslog,ubuntu
sudo:x:27:ubuntu
ubuntu:x:1000:
$ grep 'root\|ubuntu' /etc/group
root:x:0:
adm:x:4:syslog,ubuntu
sudo:x:27:ubuntu
ubuntu:x:1000:
$ grep -o 'x:[0-9]*' /etc/hostname /etc/group | head -3
/etc/group:x:0
/etc/group:x:1
/etc/group:x:2
$ grep -w sudo /etc/group
sudo:x:27:ubuntu
$ grep -l root /etc/passwd /etc/hostname /etc/group
/etc/passwd
/etc/group
$ grep -q root /etc/passwd && echo found
found
$ grep -r DB_PASSWORD /var/www
/var/www/html/config.php:define('DB_PASSWORD', 'Wint3r!2024#shop');
$ grep nothing /etc/passwd
[exit 1]
$ grep x /nope
grep: /nope: No such file or directory
[exit 2]
$ grep x /etc
grep: /etc: Is a directory
[exit 2]
$ grep
Usage: grep [OPTION]... PATTERNS [FILE]...
Try 'grep --help' for more information.
[exit 2]
$ cat /proc/cpuinfo | grep 'model name' | uniq
model name	: Intel(R) Xeon(R) Platinum 8259CL CPU @ 2.50GHz
